auditorRole: Independent mobile, accessibility and help customer auditor
persona: 30-year-old nontechnical applicant using a phone with a readable CV

timing.notes: Audit wall time, not a human task-completion benchmark. UI tool wall times included ~0.39 s for several step changes and 3.30 s for PDF preview generation plus observation; these are not browser performance measurements.

scope.privateDemoLimit: FICTIONAL LOCAL DEMO: real product screens with fictional data and in-memory service; external network blocked. This is not evidence of real account, cloud, source, model, mailbox or application execution.
scope.browser: Codex In-app Browser, independent audit-created tab 1
scope.actualInputs: Only fictional CV and fictional vacancy text
noActions: No real account creation or login
scope.suppliedCloudChecks: The parent may supply 75 cloud checks as separate root proof. This auditor did not run, inspect or count them as independent UI evidence.

fingerprint.workingTree: Modified hardening tree; base commit alone does not identify the served code.
fingerprint.note: Hashes only: no implementation source, prior grades, or target scores were read. This is a repository fingerprint adjacent to the UI audit, not a complete served-bundle fingerprint.

dimensions.label: Clarity
dimensions.rationale: Free start, required materials and applicant responsibility are explicit. Phone pages have more introductory copy and repeated choices than the task needs.

dimensions.label: Activation
dimensions.rationale: The free check starts without an account or card and a prominent phone CTA is usable. Walkthrough entry requires substantial scrolling.

dimensions.label: Form effort
dimensions.rationale: One required role, CV text and vacancy text; company and factual additions are optional. The private demo requests name, roles and location with other preferences collapsed.

dimensions.label: Evidence quality
dimensions.rationale: Literal passages, line references and missing evidence are clear. A vacancy-title line was counted as a finding in the fictional sample, so counts require interpretation.

dimensions.label: Workflow completeness
dimensions.rationale: The public six-step journey reached approval and enabled download choices, plus reuse. Private screens expose the continuing loop, but this auditor did not execute real saving or cloud work.

dimensions.label: Reuse / time-saving
dimensions.rationale: Chosen CV text carries to another vacancy and unchanged facts are explicitly reusable in the private demo. Replacing the current approved check is immediate after the explanatory warning.

dimensions.label: Help / walkthroughs
dimensions.rationale: Search, no-results guidance, task links, five interactive walkthroughs, captions and transcripts are useful and honest. There were no recorded video/audio/track elements at initial audit time.

dimensions.label: UI / accessibility
dimensions.rationale: Measured no horizontal overflow in inspected states, labeled controls, landmarks, skip link and strong visible focus. Endpoint buttons lose keyboard focus; validation does not associate its alert with the input; some link targets are small.

dimensions.label: Trust / privacy
dimensions.rationale: Local checking, optional temporary storage, private saving, factual review and user submission are distinguished clearly. This score reflects visible consent and disclosure, not a security certification.

dimensions.label: Reliability
dimensions.rationale: Sampled transitions, filtering, draft navigation recovery and clear cancellation worked. The embedded PDF panel was blank in IAB and live private/cloud behavior was outside independent test scope.

evidence.finding: 390×844 viewport confirmed; document scrollWidth 375 with the browser's scrollbar, no horizontal overflow. Mobile menu toggles expanded/collapsed with accessible names.

Fictional Operations analyst role, short readable CV and 4 substantive vacancy requirements completed all six steps. Source passages were stacked and readable on phone; approval enabled PDF/DOCX/TXT and separate report controls.
Empty role submit focused #check-role and created role=alert text 'Enter the role you want to prepare for.' The input had aria-invalid=null and aria-describedby=null.

Use this CV for another vacancy immediately returned to step 1, preserved chosen source CV and cleared role, vacancy and approval. Consequence warning was visible before the action; no confirmation or undo was shown.

Preview current PDF returned 1 page within selected maximum in a 3.30-second tool wall time. The 275×360 iframe was visually blank and AXWebArea about:blank; exact-preview new-tab link was present. Browser-specific rendering, not proven corrupt PDF.

Search 'scanned' returned 1 topic; result count has role=status. A nonsense query returned 0 topics plus shorter-search and Show all topics guidance. Related recovery link reset filters and focused #recovery.

Previous, Next, Restart, direct-step buttons and caption toggle worked. Initial tutorial heading top was 1739.73px at 390×844, beneath five stacked chooser cards. Full transcript opens and labels narration times as planned.

ArrowRight advanced a focused Next button; End reached step 6, disabled the focused Next button and document.activeElement became BODY. Home while Previous was focused likewise reached step 1 and lost focus. Home/End focused on section[tabindex=0] retained section focus.
Search 'upload' returned 3 guides. The upload-failure guide opened with sources, fictional example, takeaways and help-request guidance. Guide section anchor updated hash and focus to its section.
Audience-specific copy and CTAs are understandable and no horizontal overflow was measured. Main MBA lead text was 15px; secondary account disclosure 11px; source/reuse supporting copy 13px.

Career record exposes named labels; source suggestion preserves complete university passage, team credit, forecast and no measured savings. Opportunity form separates vacancy data from optional contact and self-reported tracking. Coverage explicitly states no run/network/document was created.

Skip link moved focus to main-content. Tab order went Target role → Company (optional) → Continue. Header Help then Free CV check restored 291-character draft and review reminder. Clear & start again exposed Keep this check / Clear current check; keyboard cancellation preserved the draft.

Standalone claim help links were ~17px high; walkthrough secondary links ~19.8px; footer legal links ~19.2px; breadcrumb links ~21.4px. Primary actions were visibly larger and focus rings readable. This is not a WCAG target-size or contrast pass/fail audit.

highestValueFixes.title: Keep keyboard focus when a walkthrough endpoint disables its button
repro: Focus Next step and press End.
Inspect focus: step 6 is displayed, Next is disabled, activeElement is BODY.
From the final step focus Previous step and press Home; the same loss occurs at step 1.
highestValueFixes.impact: A keyboard user loses their position at the tutorial boundary and must find the controls again.
acceptance: After Next/Previous, Home/End or a direct-step selection reaches a boundary, focus stays in the walkthrough on an enabled control or the focusable region.
Tab continues to a predictable adjacent control.
The role=status step announcement remains correct.

highestValueFixes.title: Associate validation errors with their inputs
repro: Open /check with an empty Target role.
An alert appears and focus moves to #check-role; aria-invalid and aria-describedby are absent.
highestValueFixes.impact: The error exists separately from the field; revisiting the field does not expose an explicit programmatic error relationship.
acceptance: The invalid field has aria-invalid=true and aria-describedby pointing to a visible error with a stable id.
The error is positioned near the field and remains reachable on phone.
Correcting the field removes the invalid state and obsolete error reference.

highestValueFixes.title: Protect the open approved check when starting another vacancy
repro: Complete and approve a fictional check without downloading or saving.
Under Your next application leave Reviewed source CV selected.
Activate Use this CV for another vacancy.
The app immediately returns to step 1 and clears the old vacancy and approval; only the preceding warning provided protection.
highestValueFixes.impact: A hurried phone user can replace their only open approved comparison before keeping it.
acceptance: A final confirmation or reliable undo protects replacement of an unsaved approved check.
The confirmation names what will carry over and what will be cleared, and offers download/save or cancel.
Cancel preserves the open check. New vacancy still requires fresh review and approval.

highestValueFixes.title: Bring the selected walkthrough above the long chooser
repro: Measure the selected first tutorial heading: top ~1739.73px.
Five large choice cards appear before any tutorial step or next-step control.
highestValueFixes.impact: The first useful instruction is more than two phone viewports down; the page asks for substantial scrolling before the chosen task starts.
acceptance: At phone width show a compact selected-task chooser and the current walkthrough before the full chooser list.
Selecting a task focuses or scrolls to the selected walkthrough below the sticky header.
Previous/Next and caption state remain accessible and do not overlap content.

highestValueFixes.title: Increase standalone secondary help link hit areas
repro: At 390×844 inspect claim-library Help with fact review and walkthrough Read task help / Help links.
Their measured link boxes are ~17–19.8px high; legal and breadcrumb links are ~19.2–21.4px high.
highestValueFixes.impact: Small secondary targets are harder to activate accurately for a phone applicant who needs recovery guidance.
acceptance: Provide larger padded hit areas for standalone help/recovery actions, aiming at 44px where layout permits and preserving clear spacing.
Check adjacent targets for accidental activation.
Retain underline or another non-color identification. Inline prose links can retain appropriate text layout; do not claim formal compliance from box height alone.

caveats: One initial pointer click on a filtered help result left /help with focus main-content and target top about 624px. Desktop keyboard recheck correctly navigated to /help#uploads and focused uploads, settled top 205px. The initial anomaly is not asserted as a reproducible defect or included among the five fixes.
Smooth scrolling produced some intermediate screenshots; stable measurements and subsequent state were used before drawing conclusions.
No contrast ratios were calculated. Contrast and focus visibility were inspected visually; this is not WCAG certification.

Initial public walkthrough inspection showed zero video, audio and track elements. A later recording/caption addition needs a targeted recheck and must not silently replace these frozen initial scores.

lateRecheck.scorePolicy: Original 82.5 mean and all original dimension scores remain frozen. No new global score.
lateRecheck.browser: New Chrome audit tab 1385099060; IAB unavailable on recheck
lateRecheck.scope: Only MH-01 through MH-05. Fictional local CV/vacancy text, no service/account/mail/model/application action.

resolutions.evidence: End from focused Next now reaches step 6 with focus on SECTION tabindex=0 aria-labelledby=wt-tutorial-title; Home from focused Previous reaches step 1 and retains the same player focus. Status announces the correct step.

Empty role, empty CV and empty vacancy submits each focused the offending field, set aria-invalid=true and aria-describedby=check-validation-error. The referenced text matched that field's actual validation message. Filling each field removed both attributes.

After approving an unsaved fictional check and starting another vacancy, Undo new application appeared with its page-only lifetime explained. Undo returned to step 5 and restored source CV, previous vacancy, and the distinct final edit (Education newline BA Business, 2021). In a direct undo→Recheck my changes & continue test, both approval/privacy checks were false and Approve, PDF, DOCX, TXT and evidence-report downloads remained disabled. No old approval was reused.

At 390×844 initial chooser contains only the selected task, with Choose a different task exposing all five. Selecting the career-record tutorial collapsed alternatives and left that selected card first and visible. First tutorial title document Y was 1000.375px compared with initial 1739.73px. Selection remains focused on the selected card; player is immediately below it, with no horizontal overflow.

Help, Read task help, How Job Loop works, Career guides and Get workflow help link boxes are all 32px high, increased from about 19.8px. Footer Privacy/Terms/Refunds remain 19.1875px high. Claim-library links were not revisited in this narrow public recheck. 32px is an improvement but below the original suggested 44px aim; target height alone is not a formal compliance result.

remainingIssues.finding: Broader original secondary-target recommendation remains partly open: footer legal links still 19.19px; walkthrough links are 32px rather than the suggested 44px aim. No remaining material keyboard/undo defect was observed in the requested reproductions.

lateRecheck.mediaPolicy: No video availability credit or playback/caption assessment. Media/metadata additions are outside this fix recheck.
lateRecheck.limitation: Keyboard DOM focus, ARIA relationships and visible states were tested. No screen-reader speech or WCAG certification claim.
